info.description:
[TODO-9.1] B? ki?m th? Postman ??c l?p cho Watch Management / DE190481.

C?CH CH?Y
1. Kh?i ??ng MSAccount (8081), MSBrand (8082), MSWatch (8083) v? API Gateway (8080), v?i SAGA_FAULT_INJECTION=true. Ng?y hi?n t?i c?a MSWatch ph?i d?ng m?i gi? Vi?t Nam (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).
2. Import ch?nh file JSON n?y v?o Postman. Kh?ng c?n import Environment, JavaScript, HTML, ?nh, CSV ho?c file d? li?u n?o kh?c.
3. Trong tab Variables c?a collection, gi? ho?c s?a baseUrl/accountUrl/brandUrl/watchUrl cho ??ng m?y ?ang ch?y. T?i kho?n seed: adminsys / @1; staff02 / @1.
4. Ch?n collection ? Run collection, ch?n ?? c?c folder 00?08, ch?y theo th? t? m?c ??nh, m?t iteration. Collection t? ??ng nh?p, l?y access/refresh token, t?o ng?y hi?n t?i UTC+07, l?u WatchID/SagaID v? chu?n b? m?i request body.
5. Xem Assertions/Test Results trong Runner. M? Postman Console ?? xem chu?i b??c Saga ???c in t? API /api/sagas/{id}. M?t s? request c? ? tr? 400/401/403/404/500; test v?n PASS khi status v? n?i dung ??ng v?i k?ch b?n.

D? LI?U V? CH?Y L?I
Tr??c khi ch?y, hai database ph?i c? ??ng 10 watch seed v? li?n k?t 5 brand theo ??. Kh?ng c?n x?a l?ch s? Saga ?? c?. M?i thao t?c ghi ch? d?ng watch do ch?nh l?n ch?y t?o ra; khi ch?y xong th?nh c?ng, watch th? nghi?m ???c x?a v? to?n b? 10 watch seed ???c so s?nh nguy?n v?n v?i snapshot ban ??u. C? th? ch?y l?i to?n b? collection ngay sau l?n ch?y th?nh c?ng. N?u d?ng gi?a ch?ng, x?a watch th? nghi?m c?n s?t b?ng API DELETE qua Gateway v?i token admin, ho?c kh?i t?o l?i c? DBWatch v? DBBrand tr??c khi ch?y l?i.

PH?M VI T? ??NG
124 request ki?m tra Gateway v? t?ng service; ??ng nh?p, t?i kho?n inactive, refresh token, ch? k? JWT, gi? m?o role, quy?n Admin, m?i field b?t bu?c, name > 10, price >= 100, releaseDate = h?m nay, category h?p l?, CRUD, idempotency participant, snapshot restore, th? t? b? tr? LIFO, DELETE pivot v? Saga monitoring. Sau m?i k?ch b?n A?G, collection ??i chi?u to?n b? watchIds/watchCount c?a c? 5 brand v?i danh s?ch watches ?? ph?t hi?n li?n k?t thi?u, th?a ho?c sai brand.

K?CH B?N H? T?NG TH? C?NG
Collection t? ??ng gi? l?p l?i sau local commit qua X-Saga-Fail-After-Step. Vi?c t?t service, ??t breakpoint ho?c ch?y SQL c?n thao t?c tr?n m?i tr??ng b?n ngo?i Postman; ch?ng kh?ng ???c gi? nh?n l? ?? t? ??ng ki?m th? b?i file n?y. ?? th? m?t k?t n?i th?t: l?y token b?ng request login, t?t MSBrand, g?i m?t request t?o watch h?p l? v? ki?m tra HTTP 503 / COMPENSATED, r?i b?t MSBrand l?i. ?? th? compensation c?ng l?i: ??t breakpoint sau ASSIGN_BRAND c?a CREATE c? header l?i b??c 2, t?t MSBrand r?i ti?p t?c; ??c /api/sagas/{id} ?? th?y 3 l?n UNASSIGN_BRAND th?t b?i v? COMPENSATING. Kh?i ph?c MSBrand v? d?n d? li?u th? nghi?m tr??c khi ch?y l?i to?n collection.

Collection ch? g?i HTTP t?i h? th?ng ?ang ch?y v? d?ng script Postman nh?ng trong JSON; kh?ng g?i Newman, Docker, Python, filesystem ho?c c?ng c? ngo?i ?? th?c hi?n c?c assertion t? ??ng.
